jobs.a6cf701236fa: unclear: continuation piece of a split word in names and non-English text (species names, Portuguese, Finnish), plus ' e' or ' -' connectors after a noun.
jobs.717701d6209b: unclear: second or later word of a fixed phrase, such as ' World' in World Series, ' life' in life sentence, ' Lesser' in GNU Lesser General.
jobs.4ae9ccc2c544: Token that closes or points back in technical text: ' above' after 'the', 'aligned' in \end{aligned}, ' With' after 'End', code closers like ' };'.
jobs.930d604609e6: Code operator right after an operand: ' +', ' *' or ' &&' following a string, variable or call, and ')' closing a cast like (String).
jobs.f44d99b19eae: Mid-word subword fragment inside a longer word, such as 'val' in valley, 'HE' in SCHEMA or DHE, 'he' in heer, mostly in Dutch, Danish, Finnish text.
jobs.c97d19cc2837: A bare ':' at the very start of a text, or ' the' at the start of a fragment; fires at window start with no left context.
jobs.eb09a2d95f23: Short token after a modifier or number in scientific and legal text: '-' in 'low-', ' at' before temperature, 'P' or 'U' in citations like '500 P.2d', '477 U.S.'.
jobs.a7b114eb2e3b: Token after a legal or date setup: the day number after a month ('On April 11'), ' evidence' after 'the' in court opinions, newline gaps in case text.
jobs.16741db0ba56: unclear: boilerplate continuation in licence and court text (' forth' in 'set forth', ' all' in 'all the time') and '}' closing '{#s1' section anchors.
jobs.b0d8637c6ac0: First letter of a capitalised acronym or instrument name in science text: 'H' in HST or H-bridge, 'D' in D700, 'p' in pn, 'N' in Nd:YAG; also ' at'.
jobs.3c2152552949: The letter 'P' of a p-value in statistics text, just before ' =' or ' <' (e.g. '*P* < 0.05', 'P = 0.01').
jobs.1047e39ed58d: Closing bracket of a figure or section reference in converted papers: '](#' after 'Figure 2B', or '}' ending a '{#sec2.5' heading anchor.
jobs.2cf081644b40: Auxiliary or pronoun just before a verb in running English prose: ' now', ' was', ' have', ' shall', ' you', ' I', usually after a subject pronoun.
jobs.b518a6fb3753: Function word inside a quoted title of a song, album or book, after its first word: ' Has', ' It', ' A', ' Of', ' Is', ' Out', ' Your'.
jobs.f10e79904f16: Line-structure token in legal citations and taxonomy lists: newline after a citation or 'v.', 'Category' at the start of a line, 'Par' in genus names.
jobs.95c2019bcf50: Word right after a verb that takes a complement: ' with' after 'washed', ' him', ' them' or ' it' after 'make' or 'give', ' in' after 'resuspended'.
jobs.1b1c3f52bb3d: Mid-word fragment or hyphen inside a compound or ID: '-' in 'table-fn' or 'built-in', digit chunks in 'Box 2910', pieces like 'ge' in pengepolitik.
jobs.8a50f48b4fe8: Digit or letter chunk inside a figure or reference identifier in converted papers, e.g. 'pone.0146728', 'jcmm14382', 'OMCL2014-653732'.
jobs.c0f9ef306fc9: Middle piece of a long word split into many subword tokens, in names and technical terms (cate|ch|ism, hist|ocompat|ibility, DEVEL|OP|MENT); also LaTeX '\in'.
jobs.7b2e4268b299: Synthetic math exercises: ' =' after 'Let <var>' as in 'Let j = 9 - 6', ' from' in 'picked without replacement from', 'Is' or 'Factor' opening a new question.
jobs.441c7e5db5f0: unclear: mid-word piece of a rare proper name or foreign word (Bay|tex, Kaifi, Hug|onin, Boy|zone) and a comma after 'The thing is'.
jobs.e0c1af76eb12: unclear: small connector mid-clause in casual prose (' just', ' little', ' so', ' too', ' and'), and ' =', ' +' or '.' in math-exercise strings and number ranges.
